changeSet.author: openai
changeSet.sql:
create table enterprise_identity_connections ( connection_id uuid primary key, tenant_id uuid not null references tenants(id), provider_id varchar(100) not null, provider_type varchar(20) not null, display_name varchar(200) not null, issuer_uri varchar(1000) not null, browser_client_id varchar(300), api_audience varchar(300) not null, secret_reference varchar(500), status varchar(20) not null, configuration_version bigint not null, created_at timestamptz not null, updated_at timestamptz not null, constraint ck_eic_provider_type check (provider_type in ('OIDC','SAML','LDAP_AD')), constraint ck_eic_status check (status in ('DRAFT','VALIDATED','ACTIVE','DISABLED')), constraint ck_eic_version check (configuration_version > 0) ); create unique index uq_eic_active_binding on enterprise_identity_connections(provider_id, issuer_uri, api_audience) where status='ACTIVE'; create index ix_eic_active_lookup on enterprise_identity_connections(provider_id, issuer_uri, api_audience) where status='ACTIVE';
create table enterprise_identity_connection_history ( history_id uuid primary key, connection_id uuid not null, tenant_id uuid not null, provider_id varchar(100) not null, provider_type varchar(20) not null, issuer_uri varchar(1000) not null, browser_client_id varchar(300), api_audience varchar(300) not null, status varchar(20) not null, configuration_version bigint not null, change_type varchar(40) not null, changed_by varchar(200) not null, changed_at timestamptz not null ); create index ix_eich_connection_time on enterprise_identity_connection_history(connection_id, changed_at desc);
